<h1><strong><span style="color: #ffffff;">Stay With Us</span></strong></h1>

<h4>Accommodation</h4>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div></div></div><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-one-col tatsu-row-has-one-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-S1l4IwkZGT" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-bg-overlay tatsu-one-col tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-SJVLPkWGa"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-SJRaaph-p   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<p>All rooms are tastefully decorated in pastel tones and are air conditioned with private patios overlooking our infinity pools, lush gardens, and the ocean beyond. We replenish the toiletries daily and Wifi access is available.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div><div class="tatsu-overlay tatsu-column-overlay tatsu-animate-none" ></div></div><style></style></div></div></div></div><div class="tatsu-section-background-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-section-background" ></div></div><style></style></div><div  class="tatsu-ByZ9OXrCWT tatsu-section  tatsu-bg-overlay   tatsu-clearfix" data-title=""  data-headerscheme="background--dark"><div class='tatsu-section-pad clearfix' data-padding='{"d":"90px 0px 30px 0px"}' data-padding-top='90px'><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-has-two-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-HJl9_QHCZp" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-bg-overlay tatsu-one-third tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-ry1YXHAba"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-HycMKCgMT   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<h5><strong>Executive Deluxe</strong></h5>
<p>One King size bed with ensuite suitable for 2 guests.</p>
<p><strong>STANDARD RATE</strong><br />Ocean View: 2,550,000 VND a night<br />Pool/Garden view: 2,300,000 VND a night</p>
<p><strong>PEAK RATE</strong><br />Ocean View: 2,950,000 VND a night<br />Pool/Garden view: 2,650,000 VND a night</p>
<p>Peak rate applicable: Dec 22, 2023 to Jan 03, 2024 and Feb 08 to Feb 15 2024</p>
